refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd
# Local error if a Varlink connection is disconnected (this never crosses the wire and is synthesized locally only). error Disconnected()
# A method call time-out has been reached (also synthesized locally, does not cross wire) error TimedOut()
# Some form of protocol error (also synthesized locally, does not cross wire) error Protocol()
# A generic Linux system error ("errno"s). error System( # The origin of this system error, typically 'linux' to indicate Linux error numbers. origin: ?string, # The Linux error name, i.e. ENOENT, EHWPOISON or similar. errnoName: ?string, # The numeric Linux error number. Typically the name is preferable, if specified. errno: ?int )

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd interface was added in version 257.
Disconnected, Protocol, System, and TimedOut were added in version 257.
